description_en: Queries AI models in a source
name: GetAiModelSourceModel

parameters.help_en: The model identifier. For standard models, use the source model card ID. For logical model entries, use the vm- prefix
parameters.help_zh: 模型标识；普通模型使用源模型卡 ID，逻辑模型入口使用 vm- 标识
parameters.name: model_card_id

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success, and a specific business error code indicates failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the in-source model operation
data.description_zh: 源内模型操作返回的业务结果

availablePaths.description_en: The protocols and call paths supported by the model
availablePaths.description_zh: 模型支持的协议及调用路径

path.description_en: The call path for the model

type.description_en: The protocol type used for the call path
type.description_zh: 该调用路径使用的协议类型

credit.description_en: The credit pricing configuration for the model
credit.description_zh: 模型的 Credit 计价配置

cacheCost.description_en: The number of credits per million input tokens that hit the cache. This must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that cached input is free
cacheCost.description_zh: 每百万命中缓存的输入 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

inputCost.description_en: The number of credits per million input tokens. This must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that input is free
inputCost.description_zh: 每百万输入 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

outputCost.description_en: The number of credits per million output tokens. This must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that output is free
outputCost.description_zh: 每百万输出 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

type.description_en: The pricing method. Currently, only fixed (fixed credit pricing) is supported
type.description_zh: 计价方式，当前支持 fixed（固定 Credit 计价）

features.description_en: The set of capabilities declared by the model. The key is the capability name, and the value indicates whether the capability is supported
features.description_zh: 模型声明的能力集合，键为能力名称，值表示是否支持该能力

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

meta.description_en: The token limits and the input and output modality information of the model
meta.description_zh: 模型的 Token 上限及输入、输出模态信息

maxInputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model
maxInputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输入 Token 数量

maxOutputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model
maxOutputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输出 Token 数量

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum number of context tokens supported by the model
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的上下文 Token 数量上限

supportedInputModalities.description_en: The input modalities supported by the model

supportedOutputModalities.description_en: The output modalities supported by the model

modelCardId.description_en: The model identifier. For standard models, use the source model card ID. For logical model entries, use the vm- prefix
modelCardId.description_zh: 模型标识；普通模型使用源模型卡 ID，逻辑模型入口使用 vm- 标识

modelName.description_en: The actual model name used by the upstream service
modelName.description_zh: 上游服务实际使用的模型名称

modelProvider.description_en: The stable identifier of the model provider
modelProvider.description_zh: 模型所属提供者的稳定标识

modelSourceId.description_en: The model source ID. Use the modelSourceId returned by the CreateAiModelSource operation
modelSourceId.description_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId

modelSourceName.description_en: The display name of the model source

modelSourceVersion.description_en: The current version of the model source to which the model belongs
modelSourceVersion.description_zh: 所属模型源的当前版本

pricingStatus.description_en: The synchronization status of the model pricing configuration. A value of Pending indicates that the current version is not synchronized, and a value of Ready indicates that it is synchronized
pricingStatus.description_zh: 模型计价配置的同步状态，Pending 表示尚未同步当前版本，Ready 表示已经同步

serviceId.description_en: The ID of the actual AI service that is bound to the model source
serviceId.description_zh: 模型源绑定的实际 AI 服务 ID

source.description_en: The source of the model asset. A value of user indicates a user model, and a value of builtin indicates a built-in system model
source.description_zh: 模型资产来源；user 表示用户模型，builtin 表示系统内置模型

updateTime.description_en: The time of the last business update. The time is in RFC 3339 format and the UTC time zone
updateTime.description_zh: 最近一次业务更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式并使用 UTC 时区

version.description_en: The current version of the object. This version is used for conditional validation during update or delete operations
version.description_zh: 对象当前版本，更新或删除时用于条件校验

message.description_en: The response message that describes the result of the request
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
